findings.location: Decision, item 5; Related files (`docs/specs/action-review.md`, “The `describe` interface” and Acceptance criteria)
findings.problem: This record leaves a `describe` capability/declaration unsettled and says the fixed verb plus pin are sufficient, while the owner-approved action-review design requires the module to declare a `describe` provider and its acceptance criteria require that declaration. The same planned engine therefore has incompatible admission requirements.
findings.suggestion: Reconcile the record with the action-review spec before relying on it: either make declaration a requirement here and define it, or explicitly revise the spec and its acceptance criteria to use the module/action plus fixed-verb rule instead.

summary: The truncation contract is now defined, but the provider-admission rule still conflicts with the referenced engine design.
